I am a poor farmer here in Amhara, renting this small piece of land, only a small portion for my beans. I have no schooling but I know beans do not need much fertilizer like maize, because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil. I cannot afford much DAP, and the cooperative fertilizer is expensive and often late, so I will put just a little DAP at planting to help the young plants, but no urea. I use the seed I saved from last year — it is what my neighbors also grow, and improved bean seed is hard to find here. I have no money for pesticide, no irrigation (we depend on the meher rains), and my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves on such a small plot.
